---
title: "Stock cards"
page-layout: full
---

One card per stock. The badge shows DFO's 2024 status zone and the data tier shows how much evidence is available. Open "Full stock page" for trends, management context, and a downloadable 2-page summary.

```{r}
#| label: grid
source(here::here("R", "functions.R"))
source(here::here("R", "plot_functions.R"))
source(here::here("R", "card_functions.R"))

stocks     <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data", "processed", "stocks.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
timeseries <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data", "processed", "timeseries.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
cards      <- make_card_data(stocks, timeseries)

div(class = "card-grid",
    lapply(seq_len(nrow(cards)), \(i) {
      make_card(cards[i, ], link = paste0("stocks/", cards$stock_id[i], ".html"))
    }))
```
